nodes.name: mean_estimator.py
nodes.summary: Estimates the expected (mean) returns of assets for portfolio optimisation, providing both exponentially-weighted and simple subperiod mean estimators with annualisation helpers.

nodes.name: meanEstimates
nodes.summary: Dict-like container of per-asset mean return estimates with subsetting and missing-data helpers.

nodes.name: exponentialMeans
nodes.summary: Exponentially-weighted mean estimator that computes EWMA means over a dataset and extracts fit-period estimates.

nodes.name: meanEstimator
nodes.summary: Generic mean estimator wrapper that dispatches between subperiod calculation and exponential estimation.

nodes.name: mean_estimator_for_subperiod
nodes.summary: Computes simple per-asset annualised mean estimates over a single fit period.

nodes.name: pooled_correlation.py
nodes.summary: Computes a single pooled correlation matrix across multiple instruments' returns by stacking and downsampling their data.

nodes.name: pooled_correlation_estimator
nodes.summary: Forward-fills, downsamples and stacks a list of returns DataFrames to produce one pooled correlation estimate.

nodes.name: stdev_estimator.py
nodes.summary: Estimates asset return standard deviations (volatility) for optimisation, offering exponentially-weighted and simple subperiod estimators plus a time series of stdevs with shock helpers.

nodes.name: stdevEstimates
nodes.summary: Dict-like container of per-asset standard-deviation estimates with subsetting and missing-data helpers.

nodes.name: seriesOfStdevEstimates
nodes.summary: Time-indexed series of stdev estimates supporting lookup on a date and rolling-quantile shock scenarios.

nodes.name: exponentialStdev
nodes.summary: Exponentially-weighted volatility estimator computing EWMA stdevs and per-fit-period estimates.

nodes.name: stdevEstimator
nodes.summary: Generic stdev estimator wrapper dispatching between subperiod and exponential estimation.

nodes.name: stdev_estimator_for_subperiod
nodes.summary: Computes simple per-asset annualised volatility estimates over a single fit period.

nodes.name: test_mean_estimator.py
nodes.summary: Unit test verifying that the exponential mean estimator returns an empty mean estimate when asked for a fit period before any data exists.

nodes.name: fitting_dates.py
nodes.summary: Generates in-sample/out-of-sample fitting date periods used to roll estimator and optimisation calculations through time (expanding or rolling windows).

nodes.name: fitDates
nodes.summary: Value object describing one fit/period window with fit and out-of-sample start/end dates.

nodes.name: listOfFittingDates
nodes.summary: List of fitDates with helpers to find the most recent period before a given date.

nodes.name: generate_fitting_dates
nodes.summary: Builds the list of fitting date periods from a dataset given a date method (expanding/rolling/in-sample).

nodes.name: generate_fitting_dates_given_start_and_end_date
nodes.summary: Core routine constructing fit periods between an explicit start and end date for a given roll method.

nodes.name: _list_of_starting_dates_per_period
nodes.summary: Builds the reversed list of period start dates at the requested interval frequency.

nodes.name: _fit_dates_for_period_index
nodes.summary: Computes the fit window and period window for a single period index given the roll method.

nodes.name: _add_dummy_period_if_required
nodes.summary: Prepends a no-data dummy period so early dates are covered before the first real fit.

nodes.name: SR_adjustment.py
nodes.summary: Adjusts portfolio weights for differences in Sharpe ratio between assets using a mini-bootstrap interpolation, implementing Carver's handcrafting SR-adjustment step.

nodes.name: adjust_dataframe_of_weights_for_SR_costs
nodes.summary: Adjusts a DataFrame of weights downward for per-asset SR cost penalties.

nodes.name: adjust_dataframe_of_weights_for_SR
nodes.summary: Applies SR adjustment row-by-row across a DataFrame of weights over time.

nodes.name: adjust_list_of_weight_lists_for_SR
nodes.summary: Applies SR adjustment to each weight list in a list of lists.

nodes.name: adjust_weights_for_SR
nodes.summary: Adjusts a single set of weights for relative Sharpe ratios and renormalises.

nodes.name: mini_bootstrap_ratio_given_SR_diff
nodes.summary: Estimates the weight multiplier for a given SR difference via a small bootstrap simulation.

nodes.name: weights_given_SR_diff
nodes.summary: Computes optimal weights between two assets for a given SR difference and confidence interval.

nodes.name: cleaning.py
nodes.summary: Cleans portfolio weights by backfilling missing assets with neutral (must-have) weights, used to stabilise optimisation when assets lack history.

nodes.name: clean_weights
nodes.summary: Replaces missing weights with must-have neutral defaults, returning a portfolioWeights object.

nodes.name: clean_list_of_weights
nodes.summary: Core cleaning routine that fills NaN weights from must-have flags scaled by a fraction.

nodes.name: get_must_have_dict_from_data
nodes.summary: Derives a per-asset must-have flag dict from which columns of the data have at least one value.

nodes.name: call_optimiser.py
nodes.summary: Dispatches to the appropriate optimisation method (equal weights, one period, shrinkage, handcraft) from a registry and handles the no-valid-data case.

nodes.name: optimiser_for_method
nodes.summary: Splits estimates into valid/invalid assets, runs the chosen optimiser on valid data and recombines with zero weights for missing assets.

nodes.name: call_optimiser
nodes.summary: Looks up the optimisation function in the registry by method name and invokes it.

nodes.name: equal_weights.py
nodes.summary: Trivial optimiser returning one-over-N equal portfolio weights for the supplied estimates.

nodes.name: handcraft.py
nodes.summary: Implements Carver's handcrafting optimiser: recursively clusters correlated assets into sub-portfolios, assigns one-over-N risk weights and adjusts for Sharpe ratio and diversification.

nodes.name: handcraft_optimisation
nodes.summary: Entry point that builds handcrafted risk weights for valid data and wraps them with estimates.

nodes.name: handcraftPortfolio
nodes.summary: Represents a (possibly nested) handcrafted portfolio computing risk weights, diversification multiplier and SR adjustments recursively over clustered sub-portfolios.

nodes.name: get_handcrafted_portfolio_weights_for_valid_data
nodes.summary: Builds a handcraftPortfolio and returns its risk weights, optionally equalising vols/SR.

nodes.name: aggregate_risk_weights_over_sub_portfolios
nodes.summary: Combines sub-portfolio risk weights weighted by each sub-portfolio's allocation and diversification.

nodes.name: adjust_weights_for_SR_on_handcrafted_portfolio
nodes.summary: Applies the SR adjustment to a handcrafted portfolio's raw risk weights.

nodes.name: one_period.py
nodes.summary: Thin optimiser that runs a single-period mean-variance optimisation on the supplied estimates.

nodes.name: shrinkage.py
nodes.summary: Optimiser that shrinks correlations and mean estimates toward neutral targets before running a single-period optimisation.

nodes.name: portfolio_optimiser.py
nodes.summary: Orchestrates portfolio weight estimation for a single fit period: builds correlation/mean/stdev estimators from config, assembles Estimates, runs the chosen optimiser and cleans the resulting weights.

nodes.name: portfolioOptimiser
nodes.summary: Configurable optimiser that resolves estimator functions, computes per-period estimates and produces cleaned portfolio weights via the selected method.

nodes.name: shared.py
nodes.summary: Shared mean-variance optimisation primitives: builds covariance from correlation and stdev, runs the scipy SLSQP optimiser to maximise Sharpe ratio, and provides NaN-handling fixers.

nodes.name: optimise_given_estimates
nodes.summary: Top-level optimiser that equalises estimates as requested then optimises and wraps the resulting weights.

nodes.name: optimise_from_processed_estimates
nodes.summary: Builds sigma from correlation and stdev then runs the mean-variance optimisation.

nodes.name: optimise_from_sigma_and_mean_list
nodes.summary: Runs the constrained SLSQP optimisation maximising negative-Sharpe over the covariance and means.

nodes.name: fix_vector
nodes.summary: Replaces NaN entries in a vector with a sentinel value for optimisation, recording their positions.

nodes.name: fix_matrix
nodes.summary: Replaces NaN rows/columns in a matrix with sentinel values so optimisation can proceed.

nodes.name: neg_SR
nodes.summary: Objective function returning negative Sharpe ratio for a candidate weight vector.

nodes.name: weights.py
nodes.summary: Core data model for portfolio weights: a dict-like portfolioWeights class with arithmetic, subsetting, integer rounding and portfolio-stdev calculation, plus a time series of weights and one-over-N helpers.

nodes.name: portfolioWeights
nodes.summary: Dict-like per-asset weight container supporting arithmetic operators, reordering, integer rounding, sub-portfolio aggregation and portfolio standard-deviation computation.

nodes.name: seriesOfPortfolioWeights
nodes.summary: Time-indexed DataFrame of portfolio weights with date lookup and leverage helpers.

nodes.name: one_over_n_weights_given_asset_names
nodes.summary: Returns equal one-over-N portfolioWeights for a list of asset names.

nodes.name: portfolio_risk.py
nodes.summary: Computes portfolio-level risk over time from per-asset weights, correlations and standard deviations, including covariance matrix assembly for each date.

nodes.name: calc_portfolio_risk_series
nodes.summary: Iterates dates to compute a time series of annualised portfolio standard deviation from weights and a covariance matrix.

nodes.name: get_covariance_matrix
nodes.summary: Builds a covariance matrix for a date from the correlation list and stdev estimates.

nodes.name: calc_sum_annualised_risk_given_portfolio_weights
nodes.summary: Computes the simple sum of absolute weighted annualised risk across instruments.

nodes.name: diagoutput.py
nodes.summary: Diagnostic reporting stage that inspects a backtest system to check forecast scaling, export estimated config parameters as YAML, and explain calculation details per instrument.

nodes.name: systemDiag
nodes.summary: Wraps a system to extract estimated forecast scalars, weights, diversification multipliers and full calculation breakdowns for diagnostics and YAML config export.

nodes.name: forecast_mapping.py
nodes.summary: Implements forecast mapping that non-linearly rescales raw forecasts to reduce small positions, per Carver's position-inertia/forecast-mapping technique.

nodes.name: estimate_mapping_params
nodes.summary: Derives forecast-mapping parameters (threshold, cap, slope) from a single scaling parameter.

nodes.name: map_forecast_value_scalar
nodes.summary: Maps a single forecast value through the piecewise-linear mapping function.

nodes.name: map_forecast_value
nodes.summary: Applies the forecast mapping element-wise across a forecast series.

nodes.name: buffering.py
nodes.summary: Tracking-error buffering for the dynamic optimised system: computes how far to move from prior toward optimal positions to balance trading cost against tracking error.

nodes.name: adjust_weights_with_factor
nodes.summary: Blends prior and optimised weights by an adjustment factor and rounds the resulting trades to contract space.

nodes.name: calculate_adjustment_factor
nodes.summary: Computes the buffer adjustment factor from the speed control and the prior tracking error.

nodes.name: calculate_adjusting_trades_rounding_in_contract_space
nodes.summary: Rounds weight-space adjusting trades into whole-contract space.

nodes.name: data_for_optimisation.py
nodes.summary: Holds and lazily converts all per-instrument inputs (optimal/prior weights, covariance, costs, constraints) into numpy arrays for the dynamic greedy optimiser.

nodes.name: dataForOptimisation
nodes.summary: Caching container that transforms portfolioWeights/covariance/cost inputs into aligned numpy arrays and constraint vectors keyed on valid-data instruments.

nodes.name: greedy_algo.py
nodes.summary: Greedy integer optimisation algorithm that incrementally adds contracts in the direction that most improves the objective until no improvement is found.

nodes.name: greedy_algo_across_integer_values
nodes.summary: Greedily steps integer position values to minimise the objective, returning the best solution found.

nodes.name: _find_possible_new_best_live
nodes.summary: Evaluates each candidate single-step move from the current solution to find an improvement.

nodes.name: _update_at_limit
nodes.summary: Marks instruments that have hit their min/max constraint so they are skipped in further steps.

nodes.name: optimisation.py
nodes.summary: Defines the greedy objective function for the dynamic small-system optimiser: minimises tracking error against optimal positions plus trading costs subject to constraints, with buffering on small tracking errors.

nodes.name: objectiveFunctionForGreedy
nodes.summary: Objective function object computing tracking error, costs and constraint penalties for candidate integer positions, driving the greedy optimiser and applying buffering.

nodes.name: optimised_positions_stage.py
nodes.summary: Backtest system stage that produces dynamically-optimised integer positions: gathers covariance, costs, constraints and per-contract values, runs the greedy optimiser per date and assembles the optimised position DataFrame.

nodes.name: optimisedPositions
nodes.summary: System stage computing dynamically optimised positions by building per-date objective instances, running the greedy optimiser and deriving costs, deflators and covariance inputs.

nodes.name: set_up_constraints.py
nodes.summary: Builds per-instrument minima, maxima, trade direction and starting weights for the dynamic optimiser from reduce-only/no-trade/long-only constraints and prior positions.

nodes.name: minMaxAndDirectionAndStart
nodes.summary: Container exposing per-code minima, maxima, direction and starting weights as portfolioWeights across instruments.

nodes.name: calculate_min_max_and_direction_and_start
nodes.summary: Computes the full set of constraint vectors across all instrument codes from the input data.

nodes.name: calculate_minima_and_maxima
nodes.summary: Derives the min and max allowable weight for one instrument from its constraints and prior weight.

nodes.name: calculations_for_code
nodes.summary: Computes minima, maxima, direction and starting weight for a single instrument code.

nodes.name: optimise_small_system.py
nodes.summary: Static small-system optimiser that greedily selects an ordered set of instruments by net post-cost Sharpe ratio, using handcrafting to size a capital-constrained portfolio.

nodes.name: find_best_ordered_set_of_instruments
nodes.summary: Greedily builds an ordered list of instruments, adding the one that most improves portfolio net Sharpe at each step.

nodes.name: find_next_instrument
nodes.summary: Finds the next-best instrument to add to the current set by post-cost SR.

nodes.name: SR_for_instrument_list
nodes.summary: Estimates the net Sharpe ratio of a candidate instrument list via handcrafting and size penalties.

nodes.name: build_estimates
nodes.summary: Assembles mean/stdev/correlation Estimates for a subset of instruments for handcrafting.

nodes.name: estimate_SR_given_weights
nodes.summary: Estimates portfolio SR for given risk weights using the cost-aware mean function.

nodes.name: net_SR_for_instrument_in_system
nodes.summary: Computes the net post-cost, size-penalised Sharpe ratio for a single instrument in the system.
